d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Tajikistan vs Senegal in Group F of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Tajikistan and Senegal shared a 1-1 group stage draw at Aspire Zone in Doha after Sidy Barhama Ndiaye put Senegal ahead in the first half and Mehrubon Odilzoda levelled from the penalty spot after the break. Senegal finish second in Group F to reach the Round of 32, while Tajikistan finish third and must wait to see if they advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
